Welcome aboard

SoulSeesBest is a multi-genre symphonic electronica experience, broadcasting from our cozy little space station. We heard the Record, we followed the signal back to Earth, and we have been making music about love and music ever since.

The player at the top of this page is SoulstiesOnly Radio itself — the full broadcast, tuning in live to whatever is on the air right now. It starts stopped, preset to a gentle 30% volume — when you're ready, press its play button. The dot beside LIVE blinks red while the station is off the air and holds solid green while a broadcast plays. It keeps playing while you move around the whole site, and its pop-out button takes it into its own window so it survives leaving the page entirely.

You Should Download Your Favorite Bands

November 20, 2026

Purchasing and downloading music directly from the band gives you complete access without needing a premium streaming service. You also contribute to the artists' creative control, their true independence, and a culture of music that comes from the soul.

I don't do it for the money. I have always avoided treating music as a business, because I want to preserve artistic integrity. Not just for my sake, but for the true loyalist.

My songs are not commercials. My art is not a marketing scheme. If I never got paid for it, I would still be creative. It's just what I do.

However, if I could make an honest living by making it available to listeners who appreciate my time and effort, I could do it full time. If I could buy a home, and support my family with it, who knows what that sense of freedom could invoke?

SOULSYNTH.01 to Be Released 11/13 with Geminids Meteor Shower

November 18, 2026

According to the American Meteor Society's 2026/27 Meteor Shower Calendar, the Geminids Meteor Shower is the strongest one of the year. So, tune in Soulsties Only Radio and the 184 BPM SOULSYNTH groove and celebrate with us!

If the video won't load here, watch SOULSYNTH.01_184bpm_techno1 on YouTube.

They are active from the 7th to the 14th but will be most active on the night of Sunday, December 13, 2026, which also happens to be National Horse Day (check out Country Quick if you love them, too!) The meteor shower that night will provide good activity before midnight in North America. It may even be visible from the Southern Hemisphere if you're persistent and stay up late!

Synthesizers + SoulSeesBest = SOULSYNTH

Get to know our newest level of evolution dedicated to the analog synthesizers, brought to life by new digital tools, in our new collections of synth grooves. #SOULSYNTH is all over socials and we've uploaded our latest grooves to YouTube. We're rolling out YouTube Shorts, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok Reels featuring our favorite sections throughout the rest of the month, leading up to the meteor shower release. Subscribe and follow on your favorite app, and don't forget to sign up for the Best Band Fan Club in the Galaxy!

To celebrate, SoulstiesOnly is hosting a Listening Party on SoulSeesBest Bandcamp, where you can buy the album and join the Fan Club — plus a special presentation of SoulstiesOnly Radio LIVE on YouTube, celebrating the astrological phenomenon. SOULSYNTH: Synths + Soulsties

November 17, 2026

In November, I discovered that one of my favorite apps is now available on the Mac, which means I can finally integrate it into my GarageBand flow. I'm grateful for the vast library of sounds, and powerful customization options it offers but, nothing sounds quite like the rich analog tones of a synthesizer.

AudioKit

I was late to the Apple craze. I was the last one in my family to get an iPhone. I used AudioKit's SynthOne to make a few beats back in 2019. I was primarily on GarageBand for iOS. I strung together a few adapters and was able to connect my Casio CTK-2000 to control the MIDI. The synthesizer gave me an entirely new sound to play with but, I couldn't get the amount of control over it that I wanted. Between that and steep learning curve (being a self-taught musician/engineer) I eventually phased out the app.

MacOS Desktop Engineering

In 2020, I finally got myself onto MacOS and GarageBand became a huge catalyst for my production and engineering path. Unfortunately, SynthOne was an iOS only app at the time so I leaned heavy into the soundpacks. A few days ago, after watching some synthesizer videos, I began to get a craving. When I found the old SynthOne app (which is still totally free, btw — SynthOne by AudioKit), I also discovered they've made a drum sequencer available (also FREE! Super606 by AudioKit). One of the only gripes I have about GB is that the classic drum sequencer that I love on iOS doesn't exist in the MacOS version. I've been making drum patterns on my phone, and finishing tracks on my desktop for years! Finally, I could simplify the workflow.

Synths + SoulSeesBest = SoulSynth

Not only did I get my hands on the AudioKit Super 606 drum sequencer (a digital representation of the classic Roland 606 physical drum machine) to make the drum patterns the old point and click way (miss you, fruityloops) but, the sequencer gives me an analog feel and I now have even more control over every element of sound. I'm so excited that I've already begun recording my groove sessions to document the process of what are sure to become classic SoulSeesBest tracks!

If the playlist won't load here, open the SOULSYNTH playlist on YouTube.

SOULSYNTH is an extension of the SoulstiesOnly Radio concept, blended with the generous use of synthesizers. I've already put some sessions on social media, and YouTube. I'd love to know what you think. Peace.

Sound Diary: Phat Atlas x SYNTHSOUL

November 15, 2026

Hello, Soulsties!

Being students of life, we consciously set the intention to learn something new everyday. Whether it's playing with new instruments, or exploring psychology, or enhancing our technical skills, we always want to be adding to our toolbox. Looking back over the years (more than a decade!) you can trace our evolution. With every new element we discover, our sound changes. Our skills develop and we thought it would be cool to document how we evolve with every new project. So, Sound Diary is a new blog series dedicated to noticing the subtle changes, and the sweeping ones, that continue to shift the definition of who we are as a band.

Phat Atlas is one of those steps in a new direction for us. It's for the girls with a… Phat Atlas. The luxury queens, flying themselves all over the world, collecting stamps in their passports, and looking great doing it. We don't aim for anything intentional when we create. We usually start with a drum pattern and just riff until something sticks. This time, we felt some reggaeton, ska-ish, world club vibes, but with an electronica twist.

If the player won't load here, open Phat Atlas on BandLab.

The drum sequence really leans into the technological debate. We want to differentiate ourselves from the use of tech in our music but, we love GarageBand, not to mention the myriad drum sequencers and plug-ins that replicate real instruments. We used the "Deep Tech" drumkit as the base to maybe "claim" tech…or something. That's not the best part, though. There have been TWO major events for us this month!

YouLean Loudness Meter

YouLean Loudness Meter is a tool for measuring volume levels that is quite useful in the mixing and mastering of our own music. It integrates directly into GarageBand and is absolutely free! It has a bit of a learning curve. There are many different values to consider, and how to effect them in our sessions. Asking a few of the right questions has given us a pretty good understanding of how to make our mixes sound as nice as possible, ready to be distributed. There are already plans of doing a "Remastered Versions" album in the near future.

AudioKit Synth

AudioKit Synth One J6 is another powerful software tool that integrates directly into GarageBand to provide a whole new universe of potential sounds! We loved the earlier version of the app but, it was only available for iPhone and iPad. We didn't have the tools to integrate it fully so, we only made a few tracks. We had to connect our midi keys directly into the phone and record the synth sounds as an audio recording. Now with MIDI function, we have even greater control of the tracks. Best part? It's also absolutely free!

You may have read our Band Statement on AI. We are strongly in favor of manual, organically crafted music. We refuse to simply ask a chat bot to "make a song" and sit on that result. However, it's a finer line than I think most of us care to admit. We are an electronica band. We use a lot of digital tools, including synthesizers and tones. You could make a similar argument about sampling records. How far away is scratching records and looping samples from generative AI? It's obviously not the same. There are serious human elements to most modern music but, unless we are explicitly acoustic, we all lean on technology quite a bit.

We won't go so far as to defend AI use in art. As artists, we are disheartened to think of all the time and energy we've put into our craft, to continually reach new levels of skill and ability, and that someone can just type a few sentences into a computer and something that sounds like us can just appear. Not to mention, most of those LLM's were trained on OUR work in the first place. As lovers of technology, we've embraced electricity and digitalization but, this hits different, as the kids say. If it weren't for new technologies advancing the world of sound, our band may not even exist. It's certainly conflicting but, we stand by our statement.

Phat Atlas is currently on BandLab and SoundClick. Would you like to have it in your favorite streaming service or on social media? Let us know in the comments.

About Soulsties Only Radio

In November of 2026, we finally hit the mark on something we've been trying to accomplish. When we released our first "radio-style" project, Soulo Run, it was a bare bones playlist. It was important for us to create value for those Soulsties that honoured us by leaving the incubator of social media, and came to our humble little Space Station. We wanted to reward you with what you probably came for, and what most websites on Earth Internet just refuses to deliver: FREE MUSIC. No gimmicks. No ads before you listen. No tricks to get your email. NO CATCH! Just come and listen, as much as you want, whenever you want, from wherever you want. Simple.

Unfortunately, that's a little harder than it looks because, even though we just want to give you access to lots of music, every website on Earth is in a desperate frenzy to capitalize on traffic, one way or another. We won't go into details, or name names. We still gotta make the best of what we have. The truth is, until we can run our own dedicated server and keep it online, we're forced to rely on what's out there. Long story short, instead of dumping a bunch of random files (and likely paying some sort of extortionary premium fee to present them), we went old skool. Not all the way back to physical media (not yet, anyway!) but to the old mp3/m3u days. One single file, packed with as much music on it as reasonable for download speed. Boom! SoulstiesOnly Radio was born!

Apparently, it caught some attention from some pretty major players. We were approached by an exec, who has asked to remain anonymous, to continue building our radio-style format. She gets our love for the nostalgia, and she's a huge fan of the band! We're working together on a probationary basis but, she's provided us with the right tools to continue building this project. More next broadcast…

Text From the Merch Table

November 8, 2026

Hey, Soulsties!

As you may be aware, streaming services only pay us fractions of a cent for your enjoyment. That's only if you pay for THEIR premium service (and/or suffer through their ad programs!) We have multiple services amongst the band so, we can't really judge but, it doesn't feel completely fair to us, or you. While we don't do this for the money, we still want you to have the best experience possible. That's why we will always have something for you to listen to, FOR FREE, just for coming to our cozy little space station here, at SoulSees.Best.

The ugly reality is that, the better funded our group is, the more creative chances we can take in developing the coolest sounds. From equipment (our engineer is currently tracking down a cassette deck for some of our most dedicated old skool heads), to electric and internet service, and machines to broadcast our latest stuff, directly to you. We are not backed by any major label (it might be the opposite in some cases, if you know what I mean). So, we do all of this out of our own pocket. For the love of the game, as they say. We don't NEED your hard earned cash. We'll keep broadcasting as long we keep loving music, and we'll keep making it available as long you love it with us!

However, we've been informed by the "accountant" that we need to start generating some income if we want this to last. (keeping in mind that his pay comes from our accounts… *side eye*) That's actually great news, though! We've found a few great services that want to provide the kind of support indie bands like us deserve! Not to mention, they care about the kind of fans that care about us. Like you, Soulsties! Again, some of these things will cost a bit up front but, they make cool stuff that you can buy to help us celebrate! The way we see it, it's a risk worth taking and an effort worth making. No Poetry.

So, if you look around the SoulSeesBest Shop you will find links to our official merch pages (we're working with our in-house design team to make new shirts!), a new option to pick up our sounds on Vinyl and Compact Discs, and our personal favorite, you can download the digital versions of our work to keep offline and listen whenever you want (even when the Wi-Fi is acting up). Plus, for our creative Soulsties, we are working on avenues for collaborations. We can make our sounds available to rappers, singers, musicians, filmmakers, dancers, and anyone else who would like to license our songs to make even more cool things! When you do, we'll share our favorites with the exclusive SoulstiesOnly Space Station, and they'll help us decide what to put on our main site. Everybody wins!

Thank you for sticking with us. While the internet sort of leveled the playing field for indie art, it's also kind of flooded the market. EVERYBODY (*audible groan*) is a brand now. It was tough enough competing with corporations for your attention but, now we're even competing against you! wtf? Anyway, we have a solid foundation in the idea that quality is better than quantity, and if you're here, you've already recognized something in that, and real recognize real. So, thank you.

While we spin things up, enjoy the free music, always on our home page @ SoulSees.Best, and go ahead and enjoy what we've allowed into the Streaming universe. If you have the means (and some options are more flexible than you may realize, check them out) purchase and Download a copy of your favorites. It gives you something of your own but, it also tells us what you really love, so we can make more like that.
